info.prompt: A neon-drenched cyber-gothic cathedral interior, void black walls etched with glowing cyan synaptic lattices, pulsating magenta heart-rate monitors embedded in skeletal gold filigree arches, translucent dice suspended in amber fluid-filled chambers with crystalline fractals, terminal code scrolling vertically across obsidian pillars, heavy vignette darkening the edges where bio-mechanical tendrils twitch.
